scope: Standing Museo Larco mansion at Simón Bolívar 1515, Pueblo Libre, Lima, with the garden-facing plaster front, raised entrance and nearby ramp and terrace.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum confirms an eighteenth-century viceregal house surrounded by gardens and located on Simón Bolívar 1515, with street entry at Navarra 169.
The current site is the later Lima home of the museum founded in Chiclín in 1926.
Museum describes the gardens within and around the exterior approach.
